_note: Quickstart: needs no API key. 5 DOIs from your own list plus 1 page of search results, free keyword screener, no AI. This is also what workflow.json ships with.

run_inputs.research_question: What does the literature from 2007 to 2024 say about mixed reality (MR) and augmented reality personal assistants and companions: their design, usability and psychological effects, specifically user experience and engagement, empathy, cognitive load and social isolation among young adults?
run_inputs.search_query: mixed reality personal assistant social isolation
run_inputs.inclusion_criteria:
Include a paper if ALL apply:
1. Published 2007 to 2024 and written in English.
2. It studies mixed reality (MR) or augmented reality (AR) personal assistants, companions, agents or avatars.
3. It looks at user experience, empathy-driven interaction, cognitive load or social isolation.
4. It is an experimental study (user trials, empirical data) or a systematic review.
run_inputs.exclusion_criteria:
Exclude a paper if ANY apply:
1. It focuses only on VR or on non-MR technology.
2. It has no personal assistant or agent inside an MR environment.
3. It has too little empirical evidence: purely theoretical, with no practical application or case study.
